title: fix: Swap client crypto.randomUUID for uuid
body:
## Bug Fixes
- **Client UUID generation works over plain HTTP** — `crypto.randomUUID()` requires a secure context, so operators on LAN IPs, `.local`, or `.onion` saw "not a function" failures and broken `EventData` PENDING events. Replaced all five client call sites with `uuid` v4, which uses `crypto.getRandomValues` and has no secure-context restriction.

## Changes
- **Add `uuid@^14` as a runtime dep** — package.json/lock updated; imported as `v4 as uuidv4` in `ai-chat-compiled-message.class`, `ai.service`, `bitcoin.service`, `event-data.class`, and `mint-swap.class`.

title: Fix: Keyset analytic accuracy
body:
## New Features

- **Fee analytics rework** — replaces the `mint_fees` snapshot API with a unified `listFees()` per-operation stream; CDK pulls fees from `completed_operations` via a proof join, nutshell LAG-diffs `balance_log` deltas; `fees_amount` now has its own dedicated checkpoint stream (was incorrectly aliased from `swaps_fee`, which is removed)
- **Mint watchdog status** — new `mint_watchdog_status` GraphQL resolver reports nutshell `balance_log` liveness (`is_alive` + `last_seen`); dashboard overlays a warning when the watchdog goes stale
- **Nutshell proto v0.20** — adds `GetQuoteTtl` RPC and `final_expiry` field to `RotateNextKeyset` request/response

## Bug Fixes

- **Per-keyset balance inflation** — `getMintAnalyticsKeysets` now nets `issued − redeemed` per bucket on the server; chart no longer mutates its input array
- **Pre-query hour-floor** — `date_end` for the pre-range query now truncates to the start of the hour in both the dashboard and keysets components, preventing a bucket from being shared with the main range
- **CDK fee join** — `listFees` switched from `blind_signature` to `proof` join so the keyset unit resolves from the input side (Cashu fees are charged on inputs)
- **Postgres GROUP BY** — `CdkService.listFees` now lists all non-aggregated SELECT columns explicitly; Postgres can't infer PK functional dependency through the derived `co` subquery
- **SQLite null params** — `queryRows`/`queryRow` now pass `params ?? []` instead of `undefined`, fixing broken WHERE clauses when no params are provided
- **JWT schema-compile guard** — `jwt_mode` is guarded against `SCHEMA_ONLY=true` so `generate:types` no longer passes an empty string as the JWT secret
- **Dashboard loading state** — `loading_mint` was not reset to `false` on analytics init or dynamic-update failure

## Changes

- **Keyset table headers** — "Proofs" / "Promises" renamed to "Proof count" / "Promise count"
- **Nutshell RPC** — wired up missing RPC socket in nutshell compose stacks
- **E2e bolt11 generation** — per-call generation replaces the fixed pre-baked invoice sidecar, eliminating duplicate `payment_hash` rejections on replay; CLN stacks use `lightning-cli invoice`, fake stacks use a bundled `gen-one-bolt11.js`
- **cdk-cli send** — pins `--mint-url` to prevent interactive prompts in non-interactive `docker exec`
- **Dep bumps** — `express-rate-limit` 8.3.1→8.5.1, `hono` 4.12.14→4.12.18

## Testing

- **4 new Playwright e2e specs** — `mint-general-keysets` (cache↔DB differential with `keysetCountsOracle`), `mint-subsection-dashboard`, `mint-subsection-info`, `mint-subsection-database` (backup/restore flow, invalid-filename blocking, malformed-file resilience)
- **AI e2e spec** — `@ai` readiness probe, `aiIsHealthy` predicate, and a dashboard assistant spec gated behind a separate `e2e:test:ai` Playwright config and `e2e:sim:*` activity simulator scripts
- **Unit tests** — `MintWatchdogService` liveness cases, `MintSubsectionKeysetsTableRow` balance arithmetic (including BigInt overflow), `MintAnalyticsService` keyset net issued−redeemed cases

title: chore: E2E Testing
body:
## New Features

- **E2E test framework** — New `e2e/` tree: five matrix configs (`lnd-nutshell-sqlite`, `lnd-cdk-sqlite`, `cln-cdk-postgres`, `cln-nutshell-postgres`, `fake-cdk-postgres`) spanning LN × Mint × DB, each with compose stack / env / mintd config, driven by a single `compose.sh` dispatcher and `e2e:{up,down,logs,ps}` npm scripts.
- **Playwright runner + specs** — `@playwright/test` with per-stack projects, port-suffixed project names, tag-based scoping (`@canary`/`@lnd`/`@cln`/`@cdk`/`@nutshell`/`@sqlite`/`@postgres`/`@tapd`/`@bolt12`/`@lightning`/`@no-lightning`/`@mainchain`/`@all`), and a per-config `setup` project that persists storage state to `e2e/.auth/`. Specs cover bitcoin-blockchain, bitcoin-general-info, bitcoin-general-wallet-summary, lightning-general-info, and lightning-general-channel-summary.
- **Supertest tier** — `e2e/supertest/` differential harness comparing Orchard GraphQL against direct backend queries via `docker exec`, rewired through `test:server:e2e`.
- **Wallet + activity services** — `wallet.Dockerfile` (cdk-cli) plus one-shot activity scripts (`activity-lnd-topology.sh`, `activity-cln-topology.sh`, `activity-fake.sh`) that seed LN forwards / mints / swaps / melts and a mempool-fill step across {1,2,5,10,25,50} sat/vB. Env-tunable via `ACTIVITY_*`; skippable via `ACTIVITY_SKIP`.
- **Bolt12 activity** — bolt12 mint/melt steps for cln-cdk (`ACTIVITY_BOLT12_MINTS`/`MELTS`) and `@bolt12` project tag.
- **Mainchain overlay** — Opt-in `compose.mainchain.yml` + `bootstrap-mainchain.sh` + `load-mainchain-snapshot.sh` point Orchard's bitcoin RPC at a real mainnet node (gated by `E2E_MAINCHAIN` + `@mainchain`).
- **Tapass channel fixture** — `lnd-cdk-sqlite` uses litd on orchard+alice, mints `TESTASSET` as a grouped asset, and opens one asset-backed LN channel via `fund-tapass-channel.sh`.
- **Bolt11 generator sidecar** — `bolt11-gen.Dockerfile` + `gen-bolt11s.py` feed the multi-unit nutshell mint.
- **Centralized image tags** — `e2e/docker/versions.env` (Renovate-annotated).

## Changes

- **Version bump** — 1.8.3 → 1.8.4 (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, README checkout tag).
- **Dev launcher** — `.claude/start.sh` sources the selected stack's env file via `ORCHARD_STACK`; `.claude/launch.json` replaces the single `client` entry with five `client-*` entries on ports 3327–3331.
- **Dropped unused helper** — Removes `createCircleSvg` from `LightningGeneralInfoComponent`; only the PNG variant is referenced.
- **Playwright artifact ignores** — `.gitignore` excludes `e2e/test-results` and `e2e/playwright-report`.

## Bug Fixes

- **CLN bolt12 destination** — `mapClnRequest` falls back to `offer_issuer_id` when `payee` is absent, fixing null destinations on bolt12 offer flows.
- **`prune_target_size` overflow** — GraphQL type widened from `Int` to `Float`; signed 32-bit Int couldn't serialize multi-GB prune targets reported in bytes by Bitcoin Core.
- **Analytics same-bucket accumulator** — Lightning `getNetBalance` and mint `getMintAnalyticsBalances` now `+=` rows sharing `(unit, date)` instead of `Map.set` overwriting them. At `hour` interval the pre-aggregator is a passthrough, so multiple positive-metric rows (e.g. `channel_opens` + `invoices_in` in the same hour) collided and all but the last were silently dropped from the Balance Sheet chart.
- **Cashu streaming final-batch drop** — `streamAndBucket` sets `cutoff = Infinity` when `batch.length < BATCH_SIZE`. The deferral that keeps same-timestamp clusters from splitting across pages had no final-batch exception, so tail rows at `MAX(created_time)` were silently dropped, producing arbitrary balance drift on backfill.

## Testing

- **Stub removal** — Deletes `src/server/test/app.e2e-spec.ts` and `jest-e2e.json` (tested a `/` route that no longer exists); `test:server:e2e` now iterates every config via `e2e/supertest/scripts/run.sh`.
- **Analytics regression specs** — Added coverage for the same-bucket accumulator (lightning + mint api) and the cashu final-batch boundary.

title: chore: Websockets Upgraded
body:
## Changes
- **graphql-ws migration** — Replaces the legacy rxjs `WebSocketSubject` + `subscriptions-transport-ws` pipe with the `graphql-ws` client (`createClient`) on the frontend and disables the legacy subprotocol server-side.
- **Centralized subscription auth** — `GqlAuthenticationGuard` now validates subscription access tokens from `connectionParams.authorization` and attaches the user to the request, replacing per-resolver `authService.validateAccessToken` calls and the `@NoHeaders()` escape hatch (decorator removed).
- **Role-based backfill subscription** — `bitcoin_oracle_backfill` now uses `@Roles(ADMIN, MANAGER)` via the guard instead of hand-rolled role checks in the resolver.
- **Schema cleanup** — Drops the per-query `auth: String!` argument from `ai_chat` and `bitcoin_oracle_backfill` subscriptions; removes the now-unused `OrchardWsRes` client type.
- **Service rewrites** — `AiService` and `BitcoinService` are rewritten against `client.subscribe()`, using a shared `hasGqlWsErrorCode` helper for 10002 (auth) and 10005 (throttle) handling and a dispose callback for teardown.

## Bug Fixes
- **HTTPS WebSocket scheme** — Derives the WS scheme from `window.location.protocol` via a new `deriveWsScheme` helper so HTTPS pages get `wss://` instead of the hardcoded `ws://` (which was blocked as mixed content).

## Testing
- **New `api.helpers.spec.ts`** — Covers `deriveWsScheme` (https/http/file/empty) and `hasGqlWsErrorCode` (matching codes, non-array payloads, missing extensions).
- **Expanded `authentication.guard.spec.ts`** — Adds subscription-path coverage: valid token attaches user, missing token throws, missing token with dev bypass returns a dev user, and invalid tokens throw.
- **`api.service.spec.ts`** — Asserts the service exposes a `gql_client` with `subscribe` / `dispose`.

title: Feat: Security Headers
body:
## New Features

- **Security headers middleware** — Adds a middleware that sets `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-XSS-Protection: 0`, `X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: off`, `X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`, and a nonce-based Content Security Policy. Also disables the `x-powered-by` response header.
- **CSP nonces via index-html middleware** — In production, a second middleware templates per-request CSP nonces into the Angular shell (`<script>`, `<style>`, and `ngCspNonce` on `<orc-root>`), enabling `script-src 'nonce-…' 'strict-dynamic'` and `style-src 'self' 'nonce-…'` without `'unsafe-inline'`. Dev emits report-only CSP with `'unsafe-inline'` so the Angular dev server keeps working unmodified.

## Changes

- **Wire middlewares into bootstrap** — `src/server/main.ts` reads `mode.production` from config, mounts `securityHeaders` on all requests, mounts `indexHtml` in production only, and disables Express's `x-powered-by`.
- **Add nonce placeholders to index.html** — Inline boot `<script>`, bootstrap `<style>`, and `<orc-root>` now carry `{{CSP_NONCE}}` for the index-html middleware to substitute.
- **Relocate `safeParse` utility** — Moves `src/server/utils/safe-parse.ts` to `src/server/modules/utilities/` with a barrel export; all `@server/utils/safe-parse` imports updated to `@server/modules/utilities`.

## Testing

- **`security-headers.middleware.spec.ts`** — Covers every header, per-request nonce generation and uniqueness, production nonce-based CSP (asserts no `'unsafe-inline'` fallback on `script-src`/`style-src`), dev report-only CSP, and the full static directive set (`default-src`, `img-src`, `connect-src`, `font-src`, `object-src`, `frame-ancestors`, `base-uri`, `form-action`).
- **`index-html.middleware.spec.ts`** — Verifies nonce replacement across all placeholders, `Content-Type`/`Cache-Control` headers, GET/HEAD-only gating, `Accept: text/html` gating, graceful no-op when the client bundle is missing, and empty-string fallback when `csp_nonce` is absent from `res.locals`.

title: Add LNbits Lightning backend integration
body:
Implement LNbits as third Lightning backend option alongside LND and CLN.
Add HTTP REST API client, configuration support, and integration into existing Lightning architecture.

Configuration

To use LNbits as Lightning backend, add these lines to your `.env` file:

# Set Lightning type to lnbits
LIGHTNING_TYPE=lnbits

# LNbits server configuration
LIGHTNING_API_URL=https://your.lnbits.server
LIGHTNING_API_KEY=your_wallet_api_key_here

Replace https://your.lnbits.server with your LNbits instance URL and your_wallet_api_key_here with your wallet's API key from LNbits.

Technical Details
  • Uses LNbits native /api/v1/wallet endpoint for reliable balance retrieval
  • Implements proper units conversion (millisats to sats)
  • Follows existing NestJS patterns for dependency injection
  • Maintains compatibility with existing LND/CLN integrations
